players.product: Precision machined chambers, weldments, gas distribution plates (showerheads), metal heaters, electrostatic chucks, coatings, gas lines and gas delivery systems for etch, deposition and implant equipment

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue rose 34.45% YoY, which the company attributes to the semiconductor upcycle: higher wafer-fab capex drove demand for equipment and parts, and orders on hand converted faster into revenue. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose 992.90% on scale effects, lower expense ratios and a fair-value gain on an equity investment.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 231,757.91 ten-thousand (H1 2025 RMB 172,377.24 ten-thousand, +34.45%); net profit attributable RMB 13,416.87 ten-thousand (+992.90%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 8,989.93 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product progress: the gas distribution plate (showerhead) business doubled YoY, with complex high-end showerheads introduced in domestic advanced-process production for etch and deposition. Electrostatic chucks completed validation at some domestic equipment makers (domestic substitution, core supplier). Metal heaters passed certification at multiple leading domestic and overseas equipment makers (core supplier), used on PECVD and strip-etch tools. New gas-cabinet designs for advanced epitaxy equipment cover leading domestic equipment makers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Surface-treatment orders: its N-series film coating completed production and delivery of an order of nearly ten-million-RMB scale in the period; its high-reflectivity gold plating took new ten-million-RMB-scale domestic-substitution orders from a leading domestic customer; its ultra-high-phosphorus electroless nickel process holds exclusive supply qualification at a leading domestic customer with annual ten-million-RMB-scale supply. Its dense YO coating, qualified at a leading domestic customer in 2025, is expanding supply across more tool types.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: the Beijing plant, positioned as a key supporting base for leading domestic semiconductor equipment makers, has been operating since H2 2025; the Nantong plant is ramping, and capacity at each base is being released progressively, lowering unit manufacturing cost.
quarterly_data.figure: Nantong subsidiary H1 2026 revenue RMB 109,098.80 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Piotech: Fortune Precision sold equipment components to Piotech (a related party because a Fortune Precision director formerly served as a Piotech director) at market prices; other related-party equipment customers include Kingsemi.
quarterly_data.figure: Sales to Piotech RMB 12,023.52 ten-thousand in H1 2026 (H1 2025 RMB 10,262.12 ten-thousand), 5.19% of same-type transactions; sales to Kingsemi RMB 300.83 ten-thousand
